plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 1973 two men, Charles Hixon and Calvin Parker, claimed they were taken aboard a craft by aliens, examined and then released while they were fishing near Pascagoula, Mississippi. He points out that Pascagoula was where the Navy built nuclear submarines, which fits his idea that UFOs are drawn to nuclear sites. In other episodes he places the town in Missouri, dates it to 1974, and credits a researcher, Luigi Vendetelli, with the nuclear link.
